I am 65, been farming these 9 mu for 40 years. My wife helps me, and two of my sons work in the city — they send money sometimes, but the farm is still my main work. I only finished primary school, so I don't read those fertilizer books. I just do what works, same as my father did, with some changes I picked up from the village.

This year I plant wheat and maize like always — that is our system here in Quzhou. Cotton I dropped years ago, prices too low and too much work picking. So really just wheat in winter, maize in summer, all 9 mu both seasons.

For wheat, I sow in October after maize comes off. I use improved seed from the dealer in town — Jimai variety, my neighbor Old Wang got good yield with it last year, about 450 kg per mu. I buy 2 bags of compound fertilizer (40 kg bags, 15-15-15) per mu as base, that gives me 6 kg N, 6 kg P, 6 kg K. Then at jointing in spring I topdress with urea, about 20 kg per mu — that is half a bag. So total nitrogen about 15 kg. I know this because I always buy 9 bags compound and 5 bags urea for my wheat, that is what I figured out over the years.

Irrigation from my well — I water before sowing, then winter water in December, then jointing water, then grain-filling. Four times. Water is not free but the well is mine so just electricity. Spray pesticide maybe 2 times — once for aphids in spring, once for wheat midge if I see them. Plough with rotary tiller, I hire the machine from village, 40 yuan per mu.

For maize, I plant right after wheat harvest in June, no-till direct seeding — saves time and money, everybody does it now. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan 958 or similar, whatever the dealer has. I put compound fertilizer at sowing, about 30 kg per mu, then urea 25 kg at big trumpet stage. So nitrogen around 16 kg, P and K about 4.5 each. Irrigate 2 or 3 times if rain is poor, usually 2. Spray once for armyworm or borer. Hope for 550 kg per mu, that is normal here.

I will not change much from last year. Fertilizer prices went up but yield matters more — if I cut fertilizer and lose 50 kg grain, I lose more than I save. Better safe.
